events.description: Called when the user asks for the next page (the `pager` form) or for more items (the `load-more` form).
events.name: onNext

events.description: Called when the user asks for the previous page; the `load-more` form has no previous button.
events.name: onPrevious

props.description: Whether the server has a page after this one: its `hasMore`. Without it the next button is disabled.
props.name: hasMore

props.description: Whether an earlier page exists, which the app knows from its cursor history. Defaults to false.
props.name: hasPrevious

props.description: `pager` shows previous and next; `load-more` shows one button that adds the next page. Defaults to `pager`.
props.name: mode

props.description: How many items are shown now, never a total: it is announced politely when it changes. Left out, no count shows.
props.name: count

props.description: True while a page loads: the button that was pressed shows a spinner and presses are refused.
props.name: isLoading

props.description: The height and text size of the buttons. Defaults to `md`.
props.name: size

props.description: The spoken name of the pagination landmark. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase in the active locale.
props.name: label

props.description: The text of the previous button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's word in the active locale.
props.name: previousLabel

props.description: The text of the next button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's word in the active locale.
props.name: nextLabel

props.description: The text of the load-more button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase in the active locale.
props.name: loadMoreLabel

props.description: Writes the count as a sentence, for example "Showing 20 orders". Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase in the active locale.
props.name: countLabel
